quiz.title: Where are you starting from?
quiz.readingStrong: You can already read — those sets will be seeded well forward if you add them, rather than starting you at あ.
quiz.readingWeak: Reading is the highest-leverage thing you can add. Hiragana first: it unlocks the furigana readings used everywhere else in the app.
quiz.loaded: Your starter categories are loaded and ready ({total} cards, {review} seeded forward because you already had them). The other categories, and the character sets, are added from Browse and Characters when you want them — loading everything at once would bury you in reviews.
quiz.loadedNoChars: Your starter categories are loaded and ready ({total} cards, {review} seeded forward because you already had them). The other categories are added from Browse when you want them — loading everything at once would bury you in reviews.
scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.lede: Full exchanges rather than isolated phrases. Every reply is one you could actually give — including the ones that land badly, which are the interesting ones.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.lede: The words that turn single sentences into conversation — and, but, so, if, when. Each lesson explains one, shows it in sentences you can hear, and drills it.
drill.missed_one: The sentence you missed is now in your reviews.
drill.missed_other: The {n} sentences you missed are now in your reviews.

reading.kanaDone: Kana drill done today ✓ — another round?
data.title: Your data
data.lede: Your progress lives only in this browser, on this device. Clearing the browser’s data or changing phones would lose it, so back it up now and then. A backup is one file: every course, your own words and their recordings.
data.notBackup: That file isn’t a Wayword backup — nothing was changed.
data.newer: That backup comes from a newer version of Wayword. Update the app (reload it while online), then try again.
data.undoHelp: You restored a backup on {date}. This puts back what was here before it.
data.undoConfirm: Put back the progress from before the restore?
today.backupNever: It lives only in this browser — no backup yet
today.backupOld: It lives only in this browser — last backup {when}
offline.ready: Offline: this course is saved on this device, so it works without a connection.
offline.partial: Offline: saving this course to this device… {cached} of {total} files so far.
offline.notSaved: This course hasn’t been downloaded to this device yet. Connect to the internet and open it once: it downloads by itself, and works offline from then on.
drill.sayHint: Say it out loud first, then check.
drill.saidRight: ✓ Nice — that’s how you say it
drill.saidWrong: It’s in your reviews now, so it’ll come back soon.
listening.title: Listening
listening.lede: Hearing what people say back — at the counter, on the bus — and telling apart sounds that are easy to mix up. A couple of minutes a day.
listening.daily: Today’s listening — a couple of minutes
listening.rule: An item is mastered once you get it right {streak} times in a row, on {days} different days.
browse.removeConfirm:
Take “{title}” out of your deck?

Its cards stop coming up in your reviews, but your progress is kept — add it again any time to carry on where you left off.
browse.removed: Took “{title}” out of your deck — your progress is kept
browse.readded: “{title}” is back in your deck, with your progress
